name: voxel-mapper
description: Planning-authoritative evidence-fusion compiler for high-fidelity 1:1 Minecraft Bedrock theme-park worlds

scripts.build:fixture: node src/cli.mjs build --park-name "Fixture Park" --osm test/fixtures/mini-park.overpass.json --bbox 51.0000,-0.0020,51.0020,0.0020 --elevation none --out out/fixture
scripts.build:alton:benchmark: node src/cli.mjs build --park-name "Alton Towers Resort" --contact "$TPMAP_CONTACT" --accept-nominatim-policy --elevation ea-lidar --buildings markers --terrain-detail-mode plausible --tree-density-per-100m2 2.8 --shrub-density-per-100m2 16 --tree-line-spacing-m 3 --vegetation-min-spacing-m 3 --max-vegetation-models 30000 --accuracy-mode plausible --out out/alton-towers-benchmark
